title: Accounts
intro: Every account the app knows about: the ones it reads from your banks and cards, and any you add yourself. Open one to see its details and its own activity.
noneX: Connect a bank or card in Settings → Connections, import a file, or add an account you keep track of yourself, like savings at a place with no connection.
workedBack: Worked back from today's balance and the transactions.
purchasesNote: What you bought with this card in each month (this month so far).
detailsX: What the app knows about this account.
rSyncTip:
Connected: the last sync read this account without a problem.
Out of date: it has not synced for more than 2 days.
Needs a code or Locked: open Settings → Connections to fix it.
rNWTip: Whether this balance is added to your net worth on Home and in Reports.
rRepTip: Whether its income and spending appear in reports, budgets and the forecast.
histX: Every time this balance was changed by hand.

f.what: What kind of account is it?
f.bankX: Connect it once. The app reads its transactions and balance for you. Read-only: nothing can be moved.
f.ownT: An account I keep track of myself
f.ownX: Cash, savings somewhere else, an investment or a loan. You enter its balance and update it when it changes.
f.connT: Connect a bank or credit card
f.loadErr: Could not load the list of banks and cards.
f.choose: Choose the company. Next you enter your login, which is encrypted and never shown again.
f.notListed: Not on the list? Import a CSV export from your bank or card (Settings → Import and export), or add it as an account you track yourself.
f.addX: For an account that has no connection to read from: cash, savings somewhere else, an investment, a loan. You enter its balance and update it when it changes.
f.editX: Change how this account is named and counted.
f.name: Name
f.curHint: This currency is not in your currencies yet. It is added to Settings → Currencies when you save, so its exchange rate can be used.
f.loanHint: A loan or debt: enter what you owe as a negative number.
f.nwT: Count it in my net worth
f.nwX: Its balance is added to your net worth. It is never counted as cash for jars.
f.repX: Income and spending on this account show up in reports, budgets and the forecast. Turn it off for something you only want to track the balance of.
f.delQ: Remove this account? This cannot be undone.
f.balX: {name} · now {amount}. The old balance is kept in its history.
f.curOk: {cur} added to your currencies and its rates loaded
f.curFail: {cur} added to your currencies. Its rates could not be fetched yet: {e}
